title: HMRC videos and webinars for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax
text:
All VAT registered businesses should now be signed up for Making Tax Digital for VAT. You no longer need to sign up yourself. HMRC will sign you up automatically unless you are exempt or have applied for an exemption.

 You should now keep VAT records and submit VAT Returns using compatible software.

 Find software that’s compatible with Making Tax Digital for VAT .

 Subscribe to receive email updates

 Subscribe to the  HMRC help and support email service  to get information on a wide range of topics for individuals, businesses, employers and agents.

 You can also:

 • make changes to your topic subscriptions

 • unsubscribe from the service whenever you want

 Registering and joining webinars

 You can register for webinars in advance but we recommend you join each webinar 5 minutes before the start.

 Information for sole traders and landlords

 Introduction to Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

 Watch a video for sole traders and landlords about Making Tax Digital for Income Tax.

 Customers — Making Tax Digital for Income Tax 

 This video offers an introduction to Making Tax Digital for Income Tax if you’re a sole trader or landlord.

 You will find out about:

 • who Making Tax Digital for Income Tax applies to

 • what it involves

 • how the changes will help you

 • joining the testing programme

 • the timeline for modernising the Income Tax system

 • where to find further support and information

 How to choose software for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

 Watch a video about choosing software for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax.

 How do I choose software for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax? 

 This video will help you understand choosing recognised software for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax and what you need to consider.

 You will find out about:

 • what you need to do

 • why you need to use recognised software

 • the different types of software to choose from

 • what you’ll need to check

 • making sure your software supports all your income sources

 Making Tax Digital for Income Tax for businesses

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about Making Tax Digital for Income Tax for businesses .

 If you have income from property or self-employment, you will be legally required to use Making Tax Digital from:

 • 6 April 2026 (for qualifying income over £50,000)

 • 6 April 2027 (for qualifying income over £30,000)

 • 6 April 2028 (for qualifying income over £20,000)

 Work out your qualifying income for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax .

 This webinar will help you understand and learn the things you will need to do.

 You will learn about:

 • using Making Tax Digital for Income Tax compatible software

 • keeping digital records throughout the year

 • sending simple quarterly updates to HMRC
